behavior.empty_inputs: Null, empty and unbound inputs omit their own Mustache sections. Missing Answer hides entry and hints without throwing.
behavior.accepted_answers:
Array items use the existing rendered
boundaries. Template JavaScript reads the DOM into an array without string splitting, delimiter parsing or backend changes. Plain text bindings with one answer per line remain compatible. Matching any one complete item is correct; a fragment or concatenation of different items is not.
behavior.normalization: NFC, collapsed whitespace, trimmed edges, case insensitive. Accents, tone marks and punctuation remain significant.
behavior.character_count: Unicode grapheme clusters excluding whitespace. Short answers have tiles grouped by words and a word count. Any alternative over 32 characters or 6 whitespace-separated words switches to one compact guide and a bounded textarea.
behavior.hints: Short answers reveal one Unicode grapheme per click through the final character. Long answers reveal eight at a time until the entire first answer is visible in a bounded scrolling guide, without creating character tiles. Disable the hint button only after the full reveal or a correct answer; remove the trailing ellipsis on full reveal.
behavior.audio: Front stays click-to-play. On each back render, play Audio first, then ExampleAudio once after a 500 ms pause. If Audio is absent, play ExampleAudio directly. Replay buttons play only the chosen field; a manual click cancels the automatic sequence. Multiple clips in a field play in order. Missing/invalid inputs hide their button; blocked playback shows a manual replay hint. Stop clips and pending playback when the card leaves the page or the document is hidden.
behavior.back: Uses the same card width, padding, mode heading and prompt/media geometry as the front. Keep the prompt or image in place; put the answer next, then immediately related reading/meaning/translation, followed by explanations, paired examples and notes. Dictation repeats the front audio button and compact borderless word typography. Optional empty inputs hide independently; no correctness verdict.
behavior.grading: Flip the card and choose the study rating.
behavior.keyboard: Short input: Enter checks. Long textarea: Enter adds a line; Ctrl/Command+Enter checks. IME composition never submits. Typed line breaks normalize to spaces.
